facts.statement: The genus Dipturus was first described by Rafinesque in 1810.
The type species of the genus Dipturus is Raja batis.
Dipturus is a large genus of skates found in the Pacific, Atlantic, and Indian Oceans.
facts.quote: Dipturus is a large genus of skates native to the Pacific, Atlantic, and Indian Oceans.

facts.statement: Species in the genus Dipturus were formerly classified within the genus Raja.
facts.quote: They were formerly included in Raja.

facts.statement: Some species originally placed in Dipturus were later reclassified into the genera Dentiraja, Spiniraja, and Zearaja.
facts.quote: Some species initially moved to Dipturus were later placed in Dentiraja, Spiniraja, and Zearaja.

facts.statement: There are currently 39 recognized species within the genus Dipturus.
facts.quote: Currently, 39 recognized species are placed in this genus

facts.statement: The genus Dipturus belongs to the family Rajidae.
The genus Dipturus is part of the order Rajiformes.
Dipturus is a genus of fish in the family Rajidae and the order Rajiformes.
facts.quote: Dipturus es un género de peces de la familia de los Rajidae en el orden de los Rajiformes.

facts.statement: Dipturus species inhabit temperate and subtropical waters of the Atlantic, western Indian, eastern Pacific, and Mediterranean Seas.
facts.quote: Se encuentra en las aguas templadas y subtropicales del Atlántico, el Índico occidental, el Pacífico oriental y el Mar Mediterráneo.

facts.statement: Fossil evidence of the genus Dipturus dates from the Rupelian to the Tortonian, spanning 33.9 to 7.246 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Rupelian to Tortonian (33.9 to 7.246 million years ago)

facts.statement: The genus Dipturus is classified within the class Chondrichthyes.
